tei:div.tei:p: "$ (61)༄༅// bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan gyi brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs dpal ster ces bya ba bzhugs so//

(62)༄༅// rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub chen tai lo pa dang nā ro pa// mar pa lo tsā mi la ras chen zhabs// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// 'ja' lus mngon gyur rje btsun ras chung pa// ye shes bla ma sbas pa'i grub thob gsum// zhang ston lo tsā dha ra shrī la// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// byang sems chen po kun ldan ras pa dang*// gzi brjid rgyal mtshan dbang phyug shes rab zhabs// gzhon nu rgyal mtshan ras chen gdan gcig par// snying nas gsol ba 'debs= /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan 'dul 'dzin ngag gi dbang*// rab 'byams smra ba sangs rgyas seng ge dang*// phyogs las rnam rgyal gtsang smyon he ru kar// snying nas gsol ba= /brgyud srol kun 'dus rgod tshang ras chen zhabs// rab 'byams rnam gsum kun mkhyen grub mchog dbang*// phrin las rgya mtsho bka' brgyud sgron me la// snying nas gsol ba= /yon tan rgya mtsho 'dzam gling rdo rje'i zhabs// ngag gi dbang po ye shes skal bzang dang*// dpal (63)ldan rgya mtsho nges don bstan 'dzin la// snying nas gsol ba= /mthu stobs rgya mtsho rin chen 'od zer dang*// rigs kun khyab bdag 'khor lo sdom pa'i dngos// bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// snying nas gsol ba 'debs so= /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nges par 'byung dang byang chub sems gnyis dang*// mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa'i// sngon 'gro'i rnal 'byor 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// smin byed dbang thob dam tshig sdom la gnas// zab gsal dbyer med bskyed rim pha rol son// snod bcud snang grags rig pa'i rnam rol kun// lha sngags chos skur 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// rlung dang gtum mos 'bar 'dzag dbu mar thim// cir snang sgyu mas chags sdang dbyings su grol// nying 'khrul rang dag nyams dang rtogs pa yi// 'od gsal mngon du 'gyur bar=

/sku gsum 'pho bas thar pa'i grong 'jug cing*// bar do'i snang cha zung 'jug longs skur shar// dngos dang yid kyi phyag rgya la brten nas// bde stong dga' bzhi 'char bar=(64)khyad par lhan skyes ye shes phyag rgya che// bla ma'i drin gyis mngon sum rtogs pa'i mthus// yid la mi byed 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ngang*// mchog gi dngos grub brnyes par byin gyis rlobs// gzhan yang gnas skabs nad gdon nyer 'tshe sogs// lam bzang sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*// mthun rkyen ma lus phun sum tshogs pa yis// don gnyis yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// ces pa'ang lam 'di la mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po bka' brgyud phrin las dbang phyug dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i smin grol gyi gdams pas rjes su bzung ba'i skabs// ris med pa'i bstan pa la mchog tu gus pa'i rgyal khams nyul ba'i bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos dpal ras chung phug gi gtsug lag khang chen po'i yang rtser bris te gsol ba btab pa siddhi rastu/ ༈ /bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi lam rim mdor bsdus pa yid bzhin nor bu'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal ldan 'khor lo bde mchog dang*// dbyer med bla ma la btud nas// snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu yi// nyams len snying po cung zad dbye// de la rten gyi gang zag brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa// smin lam yid bzhin nor bus rgyud smin cing dam tshig dang sdom pa'i kun spyod rnam par dag pa la gnas pas/ grol lam yid bzhin nor bu nyams khrid du thob nas rgyun du mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis nyams su blang pa la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes so// dang po ni/ bsam gtan la tsher ma mi 'byung ba'i gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par stan bde ba la 'dug nas 'di ltar nges par bya ste/

da lan rnyed dka' zhing phan 'dogs che ba'i dal 'byor gyi rten khyad par can 'di lta bu zhig (65)thob kyang do nub tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i gding ni med cing*/ shi ba'i 'og tu las dkar nag 'ba' zhig gi rjes su 'brangs te 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin kho na las ma 'das pas/ sdug bsngal can gyi 'khor ba de las rang gzhan sems can thams cad bsgral ba'i slad du bla ma dang dkon mchog la skyabs dang ra mdar zhu ba'i 'dun pas/ gnas yul dag pa'i zhing du gyur pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba// de'i mdun du pad nyi ro'i gdan la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gtso bor gyur ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ g.yas su seng khri pad zla'i gdan la ston pa shākya'i rgyal po la dus gsum sangs rgyas sprul sku'i rnam pa can rnam gyis bskor ba/ rgyab tu rin po che'i khri'i steng du chos dkon mchog glegs bam brag ri brtsegs pa'i rnam pa can/ g.yon du pad zla'i gdan la nye sras brgyad dang mchog zung sogs theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun/ bar mtshams dang 'og gi char gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum lta bur gsal ba'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas skyabs su 'gro bar dmigs te/ bdag sogs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun (66)rnams la= /mkha' 'gro chos skyong ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus dang*/

sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ de'i mthu la brten nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ mthar skyabs yul rnams gcig car du 'od du zhu nas rang gzhan thams cad la thim pas rgyud byin gyis rlabs par bsam/ rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pas yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje dang padma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyis ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sbyor mtshams dang sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs// rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya ba dang*/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐/ ci nus bzla/ bshags sdom spyi ltar mthar/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam// bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang skad cig gis bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba'i (67)mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad nyi zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa// de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum dang 'khril ba// dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*// zhi 'dzum mtshan dpe'i nyams 'gyur yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ// mgrin par āḥ

thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas mchod 'os thams cad spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma la// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// sdig sgrib nyes ltung mthol zhing bshags// bsod nams kun la rjes yi rang*// chos 'khor bskor bzhin bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo// 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur thob shog /maṇḍal rgyas bsdus gang shes phul// sdom bzung rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// bdag gis deng nas byang chub bar// thun mong mchog gi sdom pa rnams// bsam sbyor brtan pos bzung zhing bsrung*// spro na brgyud 'debs dang*/ gang ltar yang*// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// chos rje sangs rgyas bka' drin can la// bla ma kun khyab chos kyi sku la/ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la/ bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la/ zhes gsol ba phur tshugs su btab mthar// dpal ldan bla ma rin po ches// sku gsung thugs las byung ba yi// dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol// smin cing grol bar byin gyi rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med (68)du gyur// dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib bzhi dag /sku bzhi'i go 'phang 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas par bsam la sems 'dzin med du bzhag /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la dbang bzhi dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lam bzhi las// dang po gtso bor bum dbang gi lam la yab bka' dang*// yum bka' gnyis/ dang po la mnyam bzhag dang*/ rjes thob gnyis kyi// dang po la'ang dbang po'i rim pa dang mthun par rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang mos nyams su len par gsungs pas// 'dir re zhig bsdus pa lhan skyes yab yum gyi rnal 'byor ltar nyams su blang ba la gsum las// dang po sprul sku bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor ni/

oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3haṃ/ skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang las// nam mkha'i khams su e las chos kyi 'byung gnas phyi dkar la nang dmar ba kha sbyor gyi nang du pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i lte ba mthing nag hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas// 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi// steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre// phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drā ba las ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar bsams la/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab te srung 'khor bsgom// de'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng du// pam̐ las padma/ ram̐ las nyi ma/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi rnam shes hūm̐ sngon po skad cig gis yongs su gyur pa las// bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa// zhabs (69)gnyis g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon cung zad bskum pa'i rol stabs kyis 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ khro gnyer gso ba'i zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral ba'i cod pan gyi rtser sna tshogs rdo rje dang nor bu'i phreng ba zla tshes rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thod skam gyi rtser rin chen 'bar bas spras pa lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'chang ba/ gcer bu khrag zhag thal chen byugs pa'i sku la sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/

sgeg pa la sogs gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug sdigs mdzub dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ dbu skra sil bu'i stod cha gyen du brdzes pa'i rtser 'khor lo dang me tog gi phreng bas mdzes shing lhag ma mthur du grol bas sked pa non pa mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing*/ zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pas yab kyi sku la 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sku dang phyag mtshan yig 'bru thig le'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa khyams dang dur khrod du 'phros pas 'khor gyi lhar gyur pa ni/ khyams kyi bar snang steng 'og rnams su 'ja' 'od sprin gyi gur khang gi ngos la// rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs dang*/ 'dod yon rnam lnga'i mchod pa bkod legs du ma thogs nas mchod pa la brtson pa'i lha yi bu dang bu mos gang ba/ dur khrod rnams su phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu la sogs pa ste gzugs brnyan dang cha lugs (70)sna tshogs 'chang zhing ston pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas gang bar bsam pa ni dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag go /bcom ldan 'das la sogs pa'i yab thams cad kyi thugs kar oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po// dpral bar na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu las padma gar dbang dmar po/ phrag par bau ṣaṭa he las mi bskyod pa sngon po// mig tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ho las rdo rje nyi ma ser po/ lhu tshigs thams cad la rgyud las phaṭa haṃ zhes gsungs kyang dpe snga ma la 'di ltar snang*/ phaṭa phaṭa las rta mchog ljang khu rnams g.yas rdo rje 'phyar thabs su 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas thugs kar 'dzin pa/

gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga 'chang ba/ gcer bu dpa' bo'i rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon cung zad bskum pa'i rol stabs kyis pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi lte bar oṃ baṃ las phag mo dmar mo// snying gar ham̐ yam̐ las gshin rje ma sngon mo// mgrin par hrīṃ mam̐ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo// dpral bar hrīṃ hrīṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo// spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las gtum mo dud kha ste thams cad g.yas gri gug 'phyar thabs su 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga 'chang ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med par bsam/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ (71)sngon pos mtshan par bsam pa ni go cha bgo zhing sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pa ste nye bar bsnyen pa'i yan lag go /de dag las 'od 'phros// phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad la phog pas gzhal yas khang du gyur// nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad la phog pas/ pho thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa/ mo thams cad rdo rje phag mor gyur/ de thams cad dang bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bde mchog yab yum gyi rnam par tshur 'dus dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim// de'i rkyen gyis spyi bor bka' brgyud bla ma// snying gar 'khor lo sdom pa// yan lag tshigs bzhi dang rtsa dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs te/ mdor na lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad gsal zhing rdzogs par gyur bar bsam pa ni snod bcud sbyang sgyur dang ye shes pa gzhug pa sgrub pa'i yan lag go

/phaiṃ phaiṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pas bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyis dbur brgyan par bsam pa ni dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go /de ltar yan lag bzhi'i tshul gyis lha yi sku gsal btab nas sems 'dzin pa'i tshul la gsum las/ dang po rnam pa gsal ba ni// thog mar spyan dbus ma lta bu la mtshon na dkar nag (72)so sor ma 'dres shing skabs phyed pa/ spyan rtsa dmar zhing sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ gsal zhing dod la ngos gzung med pa la yid gtad de rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa rtse gcig tu bsgom/ mi gsal na ngag tu brjod pa'i ma bris pa'i spyan dbus ma la blta zhing yid yul du 'char ba na sems bzung*/ tshul de bzhin gyis spyan gsum smin ma dang bcas pa dang*// zhal yongs rdzogs sogs nas mthar sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs gsal rdzogs ma 'dres par sems bzung ba dang*/ de las kyang du mar spro zhing gcig tu bsdu ba dang*/ sku che chung ma nges par bsgom pa sogs kyis rtsal sbyangs shing gsal brtan thob par bya'o// gnyis pa rnam dag dran pa ni don dam par snod bcud thams cad gzod ma nas lha dang ye shes kyi ngo bor rnam par dag cing*/ kun rdzob dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa'ang*/ sa bcu/ lam lnga/ sku dang ye shes sogs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i ngo bor dran pas tha mal gyi snang zhan sbyang ngo*// gsum pa nga rgyal brtan pa ni/

rnam pa gsal rung mi gsal rung*/ sems kyi gshis ci yang ma yin pa'i rang rtsal sku dang ye shes mkha' khyab tu 'char ba'i phyir/ 'bras dus kyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i dpal 'khor lo sdom pa de nyid gang yin no snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan po bzung bar bya'o// don gnyis pa longs sku zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor la gsum las/ dang po mchod bstod ni/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad gzugs dang lang tsho'i nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pa'i rdo rje lha mor gyur pas rang la mchod cing bstod par bsam pas/ oṃ shrī he ru ka tsakra samba ra bī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ma hā arghaṃ dang*/ puṣpe sogs kyis nyer spyod dang*/ oṃ āḥrū pa badzrī hūm̐/ sogs kyis 'dod yon te/ (73)phyi mchod dang*// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod// lha mo rnams kyis sku la 'khyud pas snyoms 'jug gi bde ba skyod pa gsang mchod// de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa bla na med pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod// yab yum gyi rkang brgyad dam/ chos dbyings rnam dag ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dral// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ dpa' ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sogs rdo rje'i glus bstod nas lha mo rnams la thim par bsam/ gnyis pa bzlas pa ni/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i phreng ba bzung ste/ rang gi snying gar ye shes sems dpa'i thugs dbus su a ba dhūti'i rang bzhin gyi padma sngon po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru la gnas pa'i khams dkar cha zla ba dang*/ dmar cha nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rlung sems gnyis med kyi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po'i 'od kyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad 'geng nus pa de'i mthar thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa las/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa// ces nye snying dang*/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ḍā ki nī dzwa la samba raṃ swā hā/ zhes snying po'i sngags phreng g.yas bskor du 'khor ba/ yum gyi thugs kar pad zla nyi ma'i steng du baṃ dmar po'i mthar/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra barṇa ni yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes nye snying dang*/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes snying po'i sngags g.yon bskor du 'khor ba la sems gtad de bzla ba ngag bzlas dang*/ de'i tshe sngags phreng las 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du 'grub par bsam la bzla ba ni spro bsdu'i bzlas pa'o// mthar dbyangs gsal dang (74)rten snying tshar gsum res sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskang zhing byin rlabs brtan par byas nas/ sngar bzhin mchod cing bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol// ces gsol ba btab/ gsum pa zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor dngos ni 'og tu bshad pa'i dbang gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i lam ste 'dir yang ji ltar rigs par bsgom mo// don gsum pa chos sku 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ thun bsdu ba'am/ nub mo nyal ba'i tshe/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad la thim/ dur khrod brgyad sprul pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa rang la thim/ rang thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ de yang mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur par bsam la dbyings rig bsres te dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /spyod lam la 'jug pa na/ slar yang rang skad cig gis bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa go cha'i lha dang bcas par gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par mos te/

dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /bde mchog 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas// sogs bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab bo// de rnams kyang cung zad rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ shin tu bsdus pa lhan skyes kyi rnal 'byor dngos ni/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ shū n+ya tās nyams len stong nyid la blo 'jog pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags te/ stong pa'i ngang las snod bcud thams cad chos 'byung kha sbyor dang rdo rje srung ba'i gur khang chen po'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du bdag nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog (75)sogs yan lag bzhi rdzogs sam/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gyis dam ye dbyer med du gsal btab pa'i thugs kar sngags phreng bkod la bzlas pa la 'jug pas kyang rung ngo*// gnyis pa rjes thob thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor ni/ spyod lam sogs la 'jug pa'i tshe na'ang phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ nang rang dang bcud kyi sems can thams cad yi dam lha yi nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas bza' btung dang*// gos rgyan sogs 'dod yon rnams lha la lhas mchod pa dang*/ ye shes la ye shes thim pa'i tshul gyis zhen pa med par longs spyod/ rang gi sgo gsum gyi bya ba 'gul bskyod phyag dang bskor ba/ smra brjod gsang sngags kyi rang sgra/ dran rtog 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ngo bor lam du 'khyer/ mchod sbyin gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma chang chu nang mchod kyis bran la nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma yi dam dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho sogs gtor ma'i mgron du gyur pa thams cad oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥpadma ka ma lā ya stāṃ/

oṃ gu ru maṇḍal de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la badzra yo ga yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis phul/ gong gi sngags mthar/ ārghaṃ sogs btags pas phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na/ badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ nub mo nyal ba'i tshe chos sku'i rnal 'byor gyis gnyid kyi 'od gsal la 'jug /nangs par yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' (76)bo dang rnal 'byor mas ḍā ma ru sngags kyi gdangs su bsgrags pas sad par bsam zhing skad cig gis lha'i skur ldang*/ rnal 'byor gyi grogs su 'gro na dbang gi lhas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis dbang bskur ba'i mos pas khrus bya// slar yang sngon 'gro nas brtsams te ji skad bshad pa'i rim pa rnams thun bzhi sogs su 'bad pa drag pos nyams su blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa yum bka' bsdus pa lhan cig skyes ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khyad par ni// srung 'khor sngar bzhin gsal btab la/ de'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i sogs nas/ gdan gyi steng du rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo yi ge bam̐ dmar po/ de las 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gcer bu sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug thur du bzung nas gdug pa can rnams la bsdig cing*/ g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa'i gru mo na yab he ru ka mtshon pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga 'chang ba la dmar la 'khyug cing mdzes la yangs pa'i spyan gsum zur gyis gzigs shing khro la 'dzum pa'i zhal mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/

dri zhim li ba'i dbu skra sil bu'i stod cha gyen du brdzes pa'i rtser 'khor lo dang me tog gi phreng bas mtshan cing smad cha thur du grol bas sku sked non pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed nag po'i snying ga mnan zhing*/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas dus mtshan dmar mo'i nu phrag mnan pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i sku la mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas mdzes pa/ gzugs dang lang tsho dar la babs cing*/ bha ga dang nu ma rab tu (77)rgyas la sked pa phra ba/ bde ba chen pos rnam par myos pa'i cha byed can snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'geng nus pa/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs su byon cing skye 'gro kun gyi yid 'phrog pa'i bdag nyid ma/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i baṃ las 'od zer sku dang sogs nas/ dpag tu med pas gang bar gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi lte bar oṃ bam̐ las phag mo dmar sogs nas bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyang me long nang gi sogs nas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par tshur 'dus dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: rang la gnyis su med par thim/ de'i rkyen gyis sogs nas/ spyi bor 'khyil ba las rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ bha ga wa tī badzra wā ra hī sa pa ri wā ra ārghaṃ sogs phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying gar dhū ti'i rang bzhin gyi padma sngon po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'brur byang sems dkar dmar nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du rlung sems dbyer med kyi ngo bo bam̐ dmar po'i mthar thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa las/

oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra ba rṇa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes nye snying dang*/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes snying po'i sngags phreng*/ g.yon bskor du 'khor ba la sems gtad de/ ngag bzlas dang*/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa bya/ thun mthar mchod bstod gsos gdab rdzogs rim// thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor sogs sngar bshad pa bzhin la dmigs bsal gyi khyad par cung zad dang bcas te nyams su blang ngo*/ (78)yang shin tu bsdus pa la mos na'ang*/ skyabs sems tshad med kyi rjes/ skad cig dran rdzogs su bskyed tshul sogs yab bka'i 'gros ltar sbyar ba nyid do// zhar la bsnyen pa byed tshul gyi lag len cung zad bshad na/ mar ngo'i tshes bcu sogs dus tshes shis pa'i nyin gnas dben par bde mchog yab yum gyi bris sku dang*/ de'i mdun du gtor ma dang mchod pa'i bye brag ji ltar 'byor pa bsham/ gzhan yang dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshags su tshud par bya/ de nas sngon gtor btang*/ sgo drung du tho brtan por btsug /nang du log la srung 'khor nan tan gyis gsal btab rjes/ srod thun nas mgo brtsams te brgyud 'debs dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs skyabs sems nas bzung bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar dang*/ bzlas pa 'os mtshams kyi mthar mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma 'bul/ rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor gyis gnyid kyi 'od gsol la 'jug /nangs par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis ldang*/ sngon 'gro rgyas pa sngar btang grub na 'dir mi dgos shing*/ ma grub na skyabs 'gro/ yig brgya/ maṇḍal/ gsol 'debs rnams rab rtags mthong*/ 'bring 'bum ther/ tha ma'ang khri re las mi nyung bar rim par bsags pa'i thun mtshams rnams su ltung ba bshags pa dang sbrags te/ phyag 'bum ther kyang 'gro bar bya/ de nas dngos gzhi la thun bzhi'i rim pas bdag bskyed gtong zhing*/ bzlas dmigs ngag bzlas dang*/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa gnyis la gtso bor bya/

gzhan rlung 'gro 'ong gnas gsum sngags su shes pa'i sgo nas dmigs pa dang bcas te bgrang pa rags pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa'i mkha' gsang las sngags thams cad 'khor bar bsams te bzlas pa do li'i bzlas pa// (79)dmig pa de dang bcas te rlung bum can bzung nas sngags bzla ba spros med 'gog pa'i bzlas pa/ yid kyi ting nge 'dzin kho na las mchu sor rlung sbyor gnyis ka spangs te bzla ba shin tu spros med yid kyi bzlas pa/ ngal gso tshe gnas lugs kyi ngang la 'jog pa don dam skye med rdo rje'i bzlas pa rnams kyang ji ltar rigs pa nyams su blang*/ grangs yab bka' la rab nye snying dang*/ snying po gnyis ka 'bru 'bum/ 'bring nye snying 'bru 'bum dang*/ snying po bzhi 'bum/ tha ma nye snying bzhi 'bum dang*/ snying po nyis 'bum rnams kha skong dang bcas pa bzla zhing yum gyi nye snying yang sum 'bum bzhi khri bzla'o// yum rkyang la bsnyen pa byed na nye snying sum 'bum bzhi khri dang*/ snying po bzhi khri'o// thor thun ma gtogs pa'i thun gsum ka'i rjes sam/ ma byung yang phyi thun gyi mgor gnas yo byin rlabs dang*/ 'jug tu gtor ma bsngo/ tshes bcu rnam gnyis sogs dus khyad par can gyi tshe tshogs kyi mchod pa'ang bya/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor sogs sngar smos pa ltar la/ bzlas pa'i grangs thems nas lhag chad kha skong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sngags kyi bcu cha bya ba'am/ ma grub na yi ge brgya pa de snyed bzla/ gtong rag gi tshul du sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ dbang blang ba dang*/ chos srung gi skong bshags dang*/ tshogs kyi mchod pa sogs rgyas par bstar nas yar ngo'i dus dge ba'i snga dro'i char nang mtshams las grol la/ rim gyis grogs dam tshig dang ldan pa sogs dang 'phrad/ gzhan yang spang blang gi rim pa dang*/ dmigs pa'i bsten goms pa rnams bsnyen yig spyi 'gro ltar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa gtso bor gsang dbang gi lam steng sgo rnam par grol ba chos drug gi rnal 'byor la drug las/

dang po gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar (80)gyis lam gyi gzhung bsrang ba la/ thog mar yab yum gnyis ka'am/ yum bka' lhan cig skyes ma'i bskyed bzlas mthar phyin pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rnal 'byor dngos la/ phyi/ nang*/ gsang ba/ de kho na nyid kyi gtum mo ste bzhi las/ dang po la'ang gnyis kyi/ dang po bca' pa lus kyi gnad ni/ nam phyed nas nam langs kyi bar sogs khams snyoms pa'i skabs su/ rlung sna bug g.yon nas rgyu ba'i tshe thog mar mgo brtsams te/ de yang bde ba'i stan la lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun spyi ltar bca'/ lus sems gnyis ka dam lhod du ma song bar cha cha nas bsgrim/ gnyis pa dmigs pa sems kyi lta stangs la gsum las/ dang po sgyu ma lha yi stong ra ni/ de'i ngang las skyabs sems nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bar blo rgyud dang 'dres nges su byas pa'i mthar/ rang yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi nang nas sor mo'i rtse mo tshun chad phru ma phus btab pa ltar stong gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gsal btab la/ rlung rgyu ba g.yas g.yon gang bde'i phyogs kyi lag pa rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mos rang phyogs kyi sna bug bkag /mi bde ba'i phyogs kyi sna nas dbus cung rags la thog mtha' gnyis phra ba nas kyi dbyibs lta bu dal ba ring ba khong 'dir ma thon gyi bar du rlung zhabs ma lus par lan gsum du phud la cung zad phyir bzhag /de bzhin gzhan phyogs la'ang bya zhing phyir 'bud dus stong 'dren du song na tsho la gzan pas rgyu zhabs nan tsam bya/ rjes su lag pa'i mthe bong gnyis kyis srin lag gi 'dre rtsa mnan pa'i rdo rje khu tshur brla steng du kha sbubs nas bzhag ste sna bug gnyis ka nas lan gsum ste rlung ro dgu phrugs su 'bud/ de'i tshe phyir bsal ba na nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad spyi bo nas dud pa'i rnam pas (81)bun bun thon/ nang du rngubs pa na srid zhi'i yon tan thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam pas zhugs par bsam la shes pa rnal du dbab/

de nas rlung 'byung 'jug sngar bzhin la/ nang du gnas pa'i tshe 'og rlung cung zad 'then te kha sbyor du thub tshad bzung ba'i 'jam rlung thun bzhi bzhi'i bar yang la mi bso bar mu mthud de bsgoms pa la rlung bzhi sbyor zhes bya ste 'byongs nges su bskyang ngo*// gnyis pa dag pa rtsa yi stong ra ni/ lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar ser gro sog phra mo tsam pa/ mar sna gsang gnas su zug pa dang*/ yar sna spyi bor zang thal le zug pa'i steng du bla ma'i rnal 'byor dkyus ltar bsgom/ lus gnad gzhan 'dra ba la/ lag pa gnyis bsdoms pa'i mnyam bzhag skyil krung gi steng du bzhag ste rlung sngar las shugs drag pas sangs kyis bus la phyir thub tshad bzhag /rgyu zhabs nan tsam bya/ mi thub pa dang drag po'i tshul gyis rdzogs par rngub rjes kha na gang yod kyi mchil ma kha chang gi tshul du rngubs pa bcas steng rlung lte 'og tu mnan nas bcud la bor zhing*/ 'og rlung yang drag tu 'then/ bar rlung thad kar brgyad la dgang ba'i sbyor ba bya/ dgang ba'i rlung thog tu bskyar zhing rngubs te 'og rlung bsgril nas yang yang mchil ma mid cing 'phong rdeb pa dang bcas g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du thub thad du bsdig cing*/ mi thub pa dang thog mar nang du ci thub gcig rngub/ de nas kong ko btegs tsam byas la lhag ma ma lus par phyir 'bud pa ni drag rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan te/ de'i tshe phyir 'bud pa na spyi bo'i bla ma khru gang tsam gyi nam mkhar yer gyis byon te nad gdon sogs thon pa dang*/ nang du rngub pa'i tshe srid zhi'i yon tan bsdus pa'i tshes bla ma sngar bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de ltar bsgoms pas rlung thun re bzhin dbu ma gro sog sbom pa tsam dang*/ nas sog (82)phra sbom sogs kyi tshad ltar je sbom du song ba'i mthar lha sku'i nang gi sor mo'i rtse mo tshun chad rtsa yi stong ras gang ste/

phyi nas bltas na lha sku dang*// nang nas bltas na rtsa'i stong ra'i rnam par gyur par bsgom mo// gsum pa byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo ni/ spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngar bzhin gsal btab la/ dbu ma sba lcag tsam pa'i lte 'og sor bzhi las cung dma' ba'i thad nas skyes pa'i tshul gyis g.yas su ro ma dmar la dkar ba'i mdangs can/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar la sngo ba'i mdangs can/ gnyis ka dbu ma las sum 'gyur gyis phra ba/ mar sna cung zad 'khyil ba'i rnam pa can yi ge cha'i 'phang lta bu/ bar dbu ma ltar drang thal le ba/ yar sna spyi bo'i thod pa la sor gnyis ma reg tsam nas thur du gug ste sna bug gnyis su zug pa zhig gsal btab/ dbu ma'i nang gi lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad kyi nang thams cad khengs nus pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma grub thob kyi cha lugs can tshon gang ba/ g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar sdig cing*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnoms pa/ zhabs rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ me'i rang bzhin can me'i 'od phram phram 'phro bar bsam/ de nas bla ma'i sku las byung ba'i 'od zer dbu ma'i lam nas thon/ 'phags par mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus bla ma la thim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor mos la/ gsol 'debs spyi dang*/ khyad par/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la gtum mo bde drod kyi me sbar du gsol/ ye shes kyi gtum mo'i zhu bde rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhu bde lhan skyes kyi ye shes rang ngo 'phrod par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas rlung nang du rngub pas ro rkyang gi lam brgyud/ nyi gdan dang bla ma'i sku la phog pas de las 'bar (83)ba'i mes dbu ma dang ro rkyang gi nang thams cad khengs/ mthar rtsa gsum yang mer 'bar bas lus kyi nang gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsreg /de nas rim par gnas khang*/

lung pa/ yul gru sogs nas mar 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang me lce gcig tu 'bar bar bsam la rlung sbyor dang sbrag /thun 'jog pa na bla ma gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rtsa gsum dang lus thams cad la khyab mnyam du thim par bsam zhing sems 'dzin med du 'jog /thun mtshams rnams su'ang*/ zas gos gnas khang sogs cir snang thams cad bla ma'i ngo bo me'i rnam par lam lam gyis gsal btab la longs spyod do// 'di yan gyi lam 'di rnams re re nas shin tu 'byongs pa byung na/ 'og gi dmigs pa rnams gnad du 'gro zhing gegs mi 'byung ba yin pas gal che'o gsungs/ gnyis pa nang gi gtum mo la gsum las/ dang po rtsa yi gtso mo gcig la brtan pa ni las dang po pa la gegs cung zad che bas 'dir phyag len la mi mdzad/ gnyis pa rtsa gsum la brten pa ni/ rtsa gsum sngar bzhin gsal ba'i lte 'og gi dbu ma'i nang du khams dmar po'i dwangs ma a shad dmar po rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ tshangs bug gi nang du khams dkar po'i dwangs ma ham̐ dkar po mgo bo thur bstan zhig gsal la/ spyi bo'i bla ma la gsol ba btab cing rlung rngubs pas ro rkyang gi lam brgyud/ a shad la phog pas me 'bar la khad pa dang*/ me 'bar bas lte ba man gang ba dang*/ de las me lce phra mo rta rnga tsam pa zhig chad/ de spyi bo'i ham̐ la reg /byang sems skya chil gyis babs/ snying ga nas sor bzhi yan gyi dbu ma'i nang thams cad gang ba dang*/ de las kyang thig le'i dwangs ma ba thag tsam pa byung*/ a shad la reg (84)pas me cher 'bar bas snying ga nas sor bzhi man la khams 'bab tu mi ster zhing*/ de yan byang sems stobs rgyas pas me 'bar mi ster bar bsam la so sor rlung sbyor dang bcas te bsgom/ mthar lte snying gi 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad de kha sbyor du bzung*/ thun 'jog pa na/ lag gnyis pus steng du bzhag kha g.yas su gcu ba dang rkang g.yas gdan khar phab pas/

gtum mo'i me ham̐ la thug gi bar song nas lte snying gi bar dkar dmar 'dres par bsam// 'khrul 'khor de las ldog pas byang sems a shad la thug gi bar song bas dkar dmar 'dres par bsam la/ rlung dkrugs dang bcas lus thams cad dkar dmar 'dres pas gang bas bde drod bsam gyis mi khyab pa skyes par mos te thun mtshams rnams su'ang de nyid kyi nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o// gsum pa rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa la'ang bzhi las// dang po thig le la brten pa ni/ rtsa gsum sngar bzhin la/ snying ga nas dbu ma las gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab bzhi/ de las rtse mo gnyis su gyes pa'i brgyad// tshul de bzhin gyis mgrin par bcu drug /spyi bor so gnyis/ lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa phyi dbyibs kyi lha sku'i pags pa'i bar du zug pa'i rtse mor thig le dkar po dngul chu'i rdog ma lta bu phyed rtsa yi phyi dang*/ phyed nang du nub pa/ steng 'og tu a ham̐ dang*/ snying kha'i 'dus so las cung dma' bar hūm̐ sngon po mgo thur bstan dang*/ mgrin par oṃ dmar po gyen du blta ba rnams gsal la rlung sbyor dang bcas a shad kyi me sbar bas lte ba'i rtsa 'khor nas rim par zhugs/ thig le la ma reg tsam nas thig le las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas me mar (85)ldog /rtsa 'dab rnams kyi phyed yan thig le dang*/ man mes gang bar bsam la rlung bzung*/ de bzhin du snying gar son pas hūm̐ yang me'i thig le zlum por gyur pa dang*/ mgrin pa nas oṃ yang de bzhin gyur nas lhan cig 'bar bar bsam/ spyi bor yang 'bar 'dzag gong bzhin la/ mthar ham̐ la reg pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis me mar ldog /mgrin pa dang snying ga'i yi ge sngar bzhin gsos btab ste/ lte snying gi 'bar 'dzag dang rlung

'dis tshe la cung gzan pas/ de'i gnyen por rang rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs gnyis dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar brkyang bar bsam pa ni sku bsring ba'i dmigs pa zhes bya'o gsungs/ sems dbyer med du 'jog /mthar rlung dkrugs sogs gong bzhin no// gnyis pa yig 'bru la brten pa ni/ gzhan 'dra ba la khams rnams kyi phyed hūm̐ dkar po dang*/ phyed oṃ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhal sbyor du bsgoms la 'bar 'dzag dang rlung sbyor bya/ de bzhin du gsum pa phyag mtshan la brten pa ni/ oṃ rnams thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ hūm̐ rnams de'i nang du rdo rje dkar por bsgoms la thod pa'i tshangs bug nas bdud rtsi 'dzag par bsam/ bzhi pa lha sku la brten pa ni/ rdo rje he ru ka dkar po rdor dril dang*/ thod pa rnal 'byor ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin par gsal btab la snyoms 'jug gi bdud rtsi bskul lo// gsum pa gsang ba'i gtum mo ni/ steng rlung mnan pas ham̐ las byang sems 'dzag pa dang*/ 'og rlung bskum pas a shad las me 'bar ba dang*/ steng 'og gi rlung lte 'og dang*// 'bar 'dzag lte snying gi bar du kha sbyar bas bde brod dbyer med pa ste/ mdor na rlung dang gtum mo zung 'jug tu nyams su blang ba'i tshul yin la khyad par rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ srog shing 'khor lo'i man ngag zhal las shes so// bzhi pa de kho na (86)nyid kyi gtum mo ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i rim pa snga ma gsum gyis drod dang bde ba dang mi rtog pa'i nyams myong dang*/ de la brten nas thun mong dang khyad par gyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa skyes pa nyid/ 'dir lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su ngo 'phrod cing goms pas zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'o// de yang spyir gtum mo ni chos drug gzhan thams cad kyi yon tan mtha' dag skyed pa'i rtsa ba yin cing*/ lhag par las dang po pas lus gnad dang stong ra legs par 'byongs nas/

byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo dang 'jam rlung bum pa can sgrags te/ phyag chen gyi nyams len dang zung 'brel du bskyang ba kho na gal che'o gsungs/ gnyis pa sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol gyis lam gyi bogs dbyung ba la gsum las/ dang po 'khor ba sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi sku dpag tu med pa spros te/ thog mar dmyal ba'i gnas thams cad khyab/ de dag thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsal gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba la bkod pas rang la shin tu dga' zhing gus pas mchod cing bstod par bsams la sems bzung*/ sems zin pa na de thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bur thag bcad/ nges shes bskyed/ 'dzin med du bzhag /yang de rnams kyis mchod bstod sogs mi byed pa'i steng du/ rang la rnam pa du mas smad cing brdung brdeg sogs byed par bsam la sems gzung*/ sems zin pa na sngar bzhin sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bur thag bcad/ de bzhin du rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa la rim gyis blo sbyang bar bya'o// gnyis pa myang 'das sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ thog mar snod bcud thams cad mngon par dga' ba'i (87)zhing khams su gsal ba'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod pa la 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'i spyan sngar rang gis byang drangs te yan lag bdun pa 'bul bar bsam zhing yan lag bdun pa bya// dmigs pa gsal pa na sngar bzhin sgyu ma dang rmi lam du thag bcad/ tshul de lta bus zhing khams gzhan la'ang dmigs pa'i rtsal sbyang ngo*// gsum pa chos thams cad sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ tshogs drug la bzang ngan bar ma'i snang ba gang shar yang*/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi rtog pa spangs la sngar bzhin sgyu ma dang rmi lam du bsre bas mtshams sbyar nas/ mthar sbyang bya dang sbyong byed gnyis ka gzhi med rtsa bral du shes pas nyams len phyag chen gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa ste/

'di kho na la lam gyi snying por dril te nyams su blang ngo gsungs/ gsum pa rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs kyis lam gyi tshad bzung ba la/ thog mar sngon 'gro mos gus can bla ma/ dag snang can yi dam/ rtog pa can snang ba dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung ba ste gsum las/ 'dir phyag bzhes la dang po nyid gtso bor mdzad pas/ de ji ltar nyams su blangs pa'i tshul ni/ nyin bar snang grags rig gsum gyi rtog tshogs thams cad bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su blta zhing 'od gsal phyag chen gyi ngang du blo bzhag /nub mo nyal ba'i tshe spyi bo'i bla ma la rmi lam zin par gsol ba gdab rjes/ rab tsog pu/ de min seng ge nyal stabs kyis 'khod la/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i mgrin pa'i nang du padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba'i bla ma yi dam thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo oṃ dmar po 'od 'bar ba rang sgra dang bcas pa la shes pa gtad de/ tshogs drug gi snang ba gang shar thams cad rmi lam gyi snang bar (88)bltas nas gnyid log pas rmi lam du ngo shes pa 'byung zhing*/ de la brten nas dngos gzhi sbyang ba/ spel ba/ bsgyur ba/ sprul pa/ gegs sel/ bogs 'don lam khyer sogs la'ang rim gyis bslab/ mdor na rmi lam la 'dun pa gtso che bas nyin snang thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam gyi dran 'dun rgyun chags su bsten pa gal che'o gsungs/ bzhi pa 'od gsal ma rig mun bral gyis lam gyi gol sa bcad pa la bzhi las/ dang po thig le'i rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs 'gro nas rdor sems rang la thim pa'i bar sngon 'gro'i dkyus ltar la/ de'i ngang nas rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma mar sna gsang gnas su padma'i yu ba ltar zug cing*/ yar sna snying gar sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i tshul du kha bye ba'i steng du nyi zla'i gdan la/ rang sems bla ma yi dam dbyer med pa'i ngo bo thig le lnga tshom sran ma tsam pa/

dbus sngon po/ phyogs bzhir phyogs mdog rang 'od dang bcas pa/ rang gi smin mtshams kyi spyan dbus ma'i tshab tu thig le dngul chu'i mdog can/ phyed nang du nub cing*/ phyed phyir 'bur thabs su yod pa/ de'i thad nas gru gang dang*/ gyen du mtho gang tsam gzhal pa'i nam mkhar padma sngon po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'brur nyi zla'i gdan la sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram/ shar gyi rwa dkar po gdan la zug pa'i langs thabs can/ de'i steng gi nam mkhar bla ma'i rnal 'byor dkyus bzhin gsal btab la 'od gsal zin par gsol ba gdab/ dbang bzhi blangs pa'i rjes bla ma yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang gi smin mtshams brgyud de/ snying ga'i thig le rnams la sib sib thim pas/ de rnams las rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu bun gyis 'phros/ smin mtshams kyi thig le la (89)phog pas me shel nyi mas phog pa ltar gsal lam ste gyur pa las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis sna tshogs rdo rje la phog /de'i lte ba dang rwa rnams las rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i 'od zer byung*/ smin mtshams dang snying ga'i thig le sngar las gsal bar byas/ de lta bu'i 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dus rang gi lus kyi phyi nang dang*/ gnas khang sogs nas brtsam/ mthar stong gsum gyi 'jig rten thams cad gsal lam me re gyur pa la yid gtad de mig mi 'dzum par gnyid log /'phral du gnyid ma byung na snying ga'i shar gyi thig le nas brtsams te/ g.yas bskor gyis sems 'dzin cing*/ mthar dbus kyi thig le sngon po la sems rtse gcig tu gtad de nyal/ gnyid sang res kyis yang yang gsal btab pas nyams dang rtogs pa'i 'od gsal rim gyis zin par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa yig 'bru'i rnal 'byor ni/ thig le lnga po'i tshab tu/ dbus su hūm̐ sngon po/ shar nas g.yas bskor gyis a nu ta ra bzhi phyogs mdog dang*/ gsum pa phyag mtshan gyi rnal 'byor ni/

dbus su rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa dang*/ shar nas 'khor lo rin chen padma ral gri rnams phyogs mdog /bzhi pa lha sku'i rnal 'byor ni/ dbus su mi bskyod pa yab yum sogs rigs lnga bsgom pa ste/ gzhan dmigs pa'i bye brag rnams thig le'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin nyams su blang ngo// de yang 'di nyid kho na dmigs bsal du sbyong ba'i skabs/ gnas dben par mtshams shin tu dam par bcad/ zas gos gnas mal grib can sogs spang*/ gtsang sbra che bar bya/ dri chu bar pa dang*/ chang dang*/ bdud rtsis lus thams cad bkru zhing tshil tshan sogs kyi bku mnye bsten/ zas bcud can bza'/ nyin bar rlung sbyor dang 'khrul 'khor tsam (90)ma gtogs lus kyi bya ba gzhan spang zhing sgo gsum g.yo med du bzhag /skabs skabs su dmigs pa'i bsten goms la bslab/ lhag par 'od gsal byin rlabs kyi gnad bya ba yin pas bla ma la mos gus drag pos gsol ba btab cing sems 'dzin med du 'jog pa gal che'o gsungs/ lnga pa 'pho ba ma bsgom sangs rgyas gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lam gyi mtshams sbyar ba la sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po la'ang sku gsum gyi 'pho ba gsum las/ 'dir longs sku'i 'pho ba khyad par ba nyid phyag len du mdzad pas/ skyabs sems kyi rjes/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma mar sna lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad tsam du zugs pa phug rdug gi rnam pa can/ yar sna tshangs bug nas mtho gang tsam phyir 'thon pa zang thal le ba kṣa yig nag pos bkag pa/ snying gar rlung sems dbyer med kyi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po shin tu phra ba dwangs gsal dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phyag gnyis gri thod thugs kar bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i sku dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma yar sna gtsug tor du kha zum zhing*/

mar sna gsang gnas su thug pa'i nang du rang gi dbu ma tshud pas de'i srubs la rlung yang rgyu mi thub pa/ thugs kar gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo bam̐ yig dmar po 'od 'tsher ba rnams gsal btab nas/ bka' brgyud bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ chos sku mkha' khyab tu 'pho bar byin gyi rlobs/ yi dam lha tshogs la=*/mkha' spyod 'phyugs med du=*/rtsa ba'i bla ma la=*/gnas lugs rang grol du=*/rang sems skye med la=*/rig pa rang grol du 'pho bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes (91)gsol ba phur tshugs su btab/ rlung phyir 'gro ba na spyi bo'i kṣa yig bsal/ nang du rngub pa na bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung*/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad thob/ slar yang rang yid kyis hika brjod cing rlung phyir 'phul/ lto ba sgal pa la sbyar bas hūm̐ yig skar mda' 'phang ba bzhin song nas rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig la reg par bsam/ yid kyis ka brjod pa dang*/ rlung nang du rngub cing lto ba phyir 'phul bas mar babs snying gar gnas par bsam/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa yang yang bskyar/ thun 'jog pa na/ rnal 'byor ma 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par 'od du zhu nas dbu ma dang lus thams cad gang*/ tshangs bug yan gyi dbu ma'ang 'od du zhu nas kṣa yig sra zhing 'thas pa bcas pas bkag par bsams la/ snying ga'i hūm̐ g.yo med du gnas pa la sems bzung nas rlung bum can 'dzin/ 'byongs rtags spyi bor chu ser 'byung ba/ skrangs pa/ 'phar ba/ za ba sogs byung na skabs skabs su ma brjed tsam sbyang bas chog gsungs/ gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ nges pa'i 'chi ltas shar zhing ma bslus pa'i tshe/ dag pa'i zhing khams la dga' zhing spro ba'i 'dun pas/ tshe 'di'i lus longs spyod sogs la chags shing zhen pa btang*/ yo byad thams cad rnam dkar gyi phyogs su bsko zhing smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas btab/

sa chu la thim pa'i dus nas dmigs pa'i mgo brtsam/ phyi dbugs chad nas nang dbugs ma chad pa'i skabs su 'pho ba'i dus dngos yin pas de ltar shes par byas nas dmigs pa sngar ltar la/ hūm̐ yig rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsam nas 'dzin med du mnyam par bzhag go /(92)drug pa 'byung nges kyi chos ngos zin pas sangs rgya ba bar do yang dag zab don gyis lam gyi 'bras bu ngo sprod pa la/ spyir bar do la rang nyid ma'i mngal du nying mtshams sbyar nas 'chi kha'i 'od gsal ma shar gyi bar la skye shi'i bar do// gnyid kyi 'od gsal shar nas bzung ma sad pa'i bar rmi lam gyi bar do// 'chi dus kyi 'od gsal las yid lus su shar ba nas skye ba phyi mar nying mtshams ma sbyar gyi bar la srid pa bar do zhes rnam pa gsum du yod pa las/ snga ma gnyis kyi sbyong byed ni bskyed rim/ gtum mo/ sgyu lus/ 'od gsal/ rmi lam rnams gnas lugs phyag chen dang zung 'brel du bskyangs pas dbang po yang rab tshe 'dir zung 'jug gi sku 'grub cing rab 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi skur grol ba yin la de dag la brtan pa ma thob na 'bring gis srid pa bar do lam du 'khyer dgos pas/ da lta nas gang shar gyi snang cha thams cad bar do'i snang bar shes par byas te/ thun mong snang grags rig gsum sgyu ma lta bu'i lha sngags chos nyid kyi rol par rgyas btab/ khyad par 'dod chags gtum mo dang bsre ba/ zhe sdang sgyu lus dang bsre ba/ gti mug 'od gsal dang bsre ba/ nga rgyal bskyed rim dang bsre ba/ phrag dog dag snang dang bsre ba rnams skabs su gang babs par nyams su blang*/ mdor na rnam pa kun tu tha mal 'khrul snang gi gzhan dbang du ma song bar gang shar lha dang ye shes su 'char ba zhig byung na bar do'i nyams len thams cad kyang de ka la tshang ba yin no gsungs/ de yang snyan brgyud rang gzhung ltar na/

'pho ba dang grong 'jug tha dad du bgrangs nas chos drug tu byas/ bar do 'og tu 'chad pa sogs dbye bsdu mi 'dra ba mang yang*/ 'dir ni yongs grags dang sgo bstun nas/ nyin par mnyam (93)bzhag gi nyams len du gtum mo// rjes thob tu sgyu lus/ mtshan mo mnyam bzhag tu 'od gsal/ rjes thob tu rmi lam/ 'chi khar 'tshang rgya ba 'pho ba/ srid pa bar dor 'tshang rgya ba bar do'i rnal 'byor skye shi bar do gsum sbyong byed kyi lam tshang la ma nor bar yongs su rdzogs par bstan pa yin cing*/ grong 'jug gi gdams pa ni deng sang phyag len la 'debs pa nyung bas 'dir ma bris so// gsum pa gtso bor shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi lam 'og sgo bde ba chen po'i skor ni/ gzhung 'grel dang man ngag gi lung tsam ma gtogs dmigs bsal nyams 'khrid kyi rgyun mi bzhugs kyang gtum mo'i 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa la goms pa brtan pas rang lus thabs ldan nam spyi ltar nyams su blang du rung zhing*/ 'dir zhar byung de'i yan lag tu gtogs pa dpal nā ro chen po'i gsang spyod kyi dmigs rim rgyun du nyams su blang ba'i tshul mdo tsam 'bri na/ rang gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs de nyid bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i pho brang*/ steng rnams gzhal yas khang*/ 'og dur khrod kyi rnam pa 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba de na gnas pa'i gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mi sdug pa'i cha byed can du bsam la/ rang gi lus 'di de rnams la sbyin bya dang*/ dkon mchog mchod pa'i rgyur bsam/ sems 'di de dag sbyin pa po dang*/ yid lus byang chub sems dpar bsam pas skad gzengs mthon pos/ snang srid kyi lha srin sde brgyad 'byung po mi ma yin pa gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnod byed gdon bgegs rigs drug gi sems can dang bcas pa thams cad 'dir 'dus shig /ces brjod pas/ lha srin sde brgyad kyis gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad 'ur thibs (94)se 'dus par bsams la/

de dag la snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas skyabs yul gsal btab te skyabs sems/ tshad med/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams dkyus ltar la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dbu gtsug nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs par gsal btab ste yan lag bdun pa/ sdom bzung*/ gsang spyod brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi mthar/ bdag gzhan thams cad kyis dbang blang zhing de kho na nyid la mnyam par bzhag /de nas/ phaṭa/ ces drag tu brjod pas/ rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam pas spyi bo nas thon rang lus che ba/ tsho ba/ snum bcud dang ldan par bsam/ phaṭa/ brjod pas/ rnal 'byor ma'i phyag g.yas kyi gri gug gis phung po'i thod pa rbad kyis bcad pas stong gsum gyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar bar gyur pa de nyid mi mgo skam po'i sgyed bu chen po gsum gyi steng du dpal ba rang la bstan nas bzhag pa'i nang lus dum bur bcad de blugs pas ma shong ba'i lhag ma phyi rol tu sha yi ri bo// khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ phaṭa/ thod pa'i nang gi sha rus bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chag par gyur pa dang*/ phyi rol gyi sha khrag rus pa rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ tshogs zhing rnams kyi thugs kar phog /de dag gi thugs rgyud bskul/ sku gsung thugs las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'od kyi rang bzhin can babs te thod pa'i phyi nang gi rdzas rnams la thim pas ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa sha khrag rus pa sogs 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i phung por bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mang du brjod cing*/ rang sems rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros te/ (95)mchod sbyin gyi mgron rnams la bdud rtsi'i dga' ston dpag tu med pa phul bas so sos longs spyod pas zag med kyi bde bas tshim par mos te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/

drin chen rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ phung po'i tshogs mchod bdud rtsir 'bul/ brtse bas dges bzhin bzhes nas kyang*// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// don gnyis 'grub par byin gyi rlobs// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// phung po'i tshogs mchod sogs/ de bzhin du/ chos bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral la// mched lcam rdo rje spun grogs la// zhes so sor sbyar/ yul 'di'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag la// phung po'i tshogs mchod sbyin par btang*// dga' spro ldan zhing rol nas kyang*// zag med bde bas tshims pa dang*// bu lon 'brel chags byang gyur cig /lan chags sha 'khon dag gyur cig /nyes ltung dri ma bral gyur cig /tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa byang gyur nas// myur du sangs rgyas thob par shog /de bzhin du/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad la// phung po'i tshogs mchod sbyin par btang*/ sogs dang*/ rigs drug sems can thams cad la// phung po'i tshogs mchod sogs sbyar bas bsngos/ slar yang rang gi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i rtse las 'dod pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i sprin chen po char bzhin du babs te mchod sbyin gyi mgron rnams mnyes shing tshims par bsams la/ rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /sogs brjod/ de nas rang bstan pa'i gtso bo shākya thub par gsal bas sbyin yul rnams la chos kyi sbyin pas dbugs (96)dbyung bar mos te/ chos rnams gang dag sogs chos sbyin bya/ slar yang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum las 'od zer dkar mar mthing gsum rim dang gcig car du 'phros/ sbyin yul thams cad la phog pas dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib bzhi dag /sku bzhi'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag /de nas rang nyid thugs rje chen po kha sarpā ṇir gsal ba'i phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi rtse las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa sbyin yul rnams kyis longs spyad pas sdig sgrib dag cing byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes nas rang gzhan thams cad mgrin gcig tu dge ba bsngo bar bsams la/

bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// ces sogs bsngo smon ji ltar rigs par byas rjes/ gzhi bdag la sogs pa'i mgron rnams rang rang gi gnas su song*/ gdug sems ma zhi ba rnams kyang rang la 'dus/ tshogs zhing rnams kyang rang la thim/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum brtsegs mar gyur de yang yas rim gyis thim nas mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur par bsams la gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i ngang du blo lhod kyis glod la bzhag /rtog pa gang shar yang*/ phaṭa/ ces brjod la thad kar bcad/ khyad par 'jigs skrag gi rtog pa byung na/ lus ni mchod sbyin du byin tshar nas med/ sems ni nam mkha' stong pa dang dbyer med pa'i phyir ji ltar 'jigs snyam du rtogs pa'i gdeng bskyed/ des kyang ma zhi na/ 'jigs pa'i tshe 'jigs mkhan gyi sems gang na 'dug /'jigs mkhan gyi tshe 'jigs pa gang na 'dug bltas la sems kyi rtsa ba bdar sha bcad de phaṭa/ ces brjod la rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go*/de ltar thog mar mal (97)gcod la 'bad cing*/ cung zad goms pa na gnyan khrod 'jam zhing bkra shis pa dang*/ rim gyis 'jigs shing zil che ba rnams su gsang spyod la brtson pas dang por mi 'dod pa'i slong*/ bar du btang snyoms/ tha mar mchog dngos grub pa'i rtags mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro gsungs/ bzhi pa gtso bor dbang bzhi pa'i lam phyag rgya chen po'i 'khrid tshul gyi rim pa cung zad mi 'dra ba mang yang*/ 'dir zab lam yi ge bzhi pa ltar na// dang po sems kyi gzhi rtsa bcad pa ni/ gnas dben par lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun dang ldan par byas/ ngag gnad rlung rang sor 'jog /sems kyi gnad skyabs sems nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bar nyams su blang la gsol ba shugs drag tu gdab/ de nas dbang bzhi blangs shing thugs yid bsres pa'i ngang*/ chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba ltar rang sems kyi rnam 'phrul tsam du thag bcad la de las gzhan du 'das pa'i rnam rtog gi rjes mi bcad/

ma 'ongs pa'i sngun mi bsu/ da lta'i shes pa rtsis gdab mi bya bar rang babs su bzhag pas de la mi gnas par rnam rtog zhig thol gyis 'phro ba'i tshe/ rtog pa de dang po gang nas skyes/ bar du gang du gnas/ tha ma gang du 'gags brtags pas rang sems las shar zhing rang sems su thim par mthong na/ sems de nyid kyang skye 'gag gnas gsum/ dbyibs kha dog gcig dang du ma sogs legs par brtags shing dpyad pas/ gang du'ang ma grub cing cir yang 'char ba/ nyams su myong yang bsam brjod las 'das par rtogs pa'i tshe/ gnyis pa sems kyi bzhag thabs bstan pa ni/ de ltar rtogs pa'i steng du sems mi gnas pa gnas par byed pa'i thabs drug ste/ khyung chen nam mkha' la lding ba bzhin du ma bcos (98)gnyug ma'i ngang du rtsol sgrub med par bzhag rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba bzhin du rtogs tshogs kyis g.yo 'gul med par bzhag /nyi zla sprin dang bral ba bzhin du sems nyid 'od gsal ba'i ngang mdangs ma bral bar bzhag /bu chung lha khang la lta ba bzhin du gsal la der 'dzin med par bzhag /chu dang rlabs bzhin du byung tshor thams cad rang grol gyi ngang du bzhag /nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba bzhin du rig pa rjes med kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa ste/ mdor na rang sems brjod bral du nyams su myong ba lhag mthong de'i ngang du spang blang bzo bcos med par bzhag pa zhi gnas/ de gnyis dbyer med pa zung 'jug ste mnyam rjes thams cad du lam khyer 'di dang ma bral bar bya'o// gsum pa sems kyi gol sa bcad pa ni/ yar sangs rgyas la re ba/ mar 'khor ba la dog pa/ bar snang ba la bden 'dzin/ nang nyams myong la zhen pa/ las rgyu 'bras la khyad du gsod pa sogs bden zhen thams cad gol sa yin pas/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems kyis phar btags pa tsam ma gtogs don logs su grub pa med cing sems de'ang gshis ci yang ma yin la/

gdangs cir yang ma 'gags pa'i stong pa dang rten 'byung dbyer med pa'i don la nges shes bskyed de/ don dam par gang la'ang ma zhen cing*/ kun rdzob tu las rgyu 'bras phra mo la'ang blang dor tshul bzhin du bya'o// bzhi pa sems kyi lam khyer bstan pa la drug las/ nyin mo snang ba rgyas btab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ 'di ltar snang ba thams cad rang sems 'khrul par rgyas btab/ sems 'khrul pa ngos bzung med pa sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bur rgyas btab/ sgyu ma'ang rang bzhin med pa chos nyid skye med du rgyas btab bo// nang nub 'dod yon grogs su khyer ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rab 'dod yon thams cad stong pa la stong pas rol/ chos nyid la chos nyid thim pa'i tshul gyis longs spyad/ 'bring sgyu ma la sgyu mas rol// ye shes (99)la ye shes thim pa'i tshul kyis longs spyad/ tha ma bla ma yi dam la tshogs mchod 'bul ba'i tshul kyis longs spyod do// srod la dbang po bzhi la bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ 'khrul pa'i rtog tshogs gang shar gyi rang ngo la cer gyis bltas nas/ brtag dpyad bsam gzhig gi spros pa rang sar grol ba'i ngang du blo 'jog go /nam gung shes pa bum par gzhug pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ nub mo snying dkyil du padma nyi zla'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'phro bar gsal ba'i 'od kyis snang ba thams cad gsal lam mer gyur pa la sems gtad de nyal bas gnyid 'od gsal du 'char ro// tho rangs rig pa gsal gdab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rlung rig dwangs pa'i skabs der chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid dang*/ khyad par bla ma'i man ngag rnams bsam mnos zhun thar bcad de blo la yang yang gsal gdab bo// 'chi khar ye shes zang thal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ nam 'chi ba'i tshe phyi nang gi dngos po la chags sdang gi rtog pa spang*/ kun rdzob tu yo byad rnams tshogs su btang*/ nyes ltung bshags/

sdom pa blang*/ nges 'byung dang*/ snying rje dang*/ smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar te/ don dam par rang sems skye 'chi med pas phyag rgya chen po yid la byar med par kho thag bcad de// bsgom med kyi ngang du yengs med du bzhag pas bar do med par zang thal du sangs rgya'o// gzhan yang gegs sel bogs 'don dang nyams rtogs kyi skye tshul sogs ni bla ma nyams myong can gyi zhal las rim pa shes par bya ba kho na'o gsungs/ gsum pa rjes ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i lam de rnams stan thog gcig tu nyams su blang ba'i tshe/ spyir bskyed rim lta bu re re la'ang lam thams cad don gyis tshang ba yin te/ rnam pa lhar gsal ba bskyed rim (100)gsal bzhin du stong pa rdzogs rim/ de gnyis dbyer med pa zung 'jug /de thams cad rang sems skad cig ma'i ngang du rdzogs pa phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len no// 'on kyang mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis so sor nyams su len na/ skyabs sems nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor bar dkyus bzhin gyi mthar/ bskyed chog rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pas yab yum gang rung gi bskyed rim gsal la bzlas pa bya/ de nas thugs ka'i sngags 'khor sogs mi dmigs pa'i ngang stong ra gsal btab nas byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo dang*/ rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan bsgom zhing rdzogs rim du bsdu/ thun mtshams rnams su cir snang sgyu ma'i dran 'dun drag tu bya/ nyal ba'i tshe rmi lam dang 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor gang rung la 'jug /skabs ci rigs par 'pho ba dang*/ gsang spyod kyi dmigs rim kyang nyams su blang*/ khyad par dus thams cad du gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len dang ma bral bar bya zhing*/ gzhan yang lam gyi yan lag tu tshe sgrub gong khug mi'i bskyed rdzogs kyang logs su gsal ba bzhin 'bad pas myur du zung 'jug 'chi med ye shes kyi sku dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// de ltar 'khor lo bde mchog gi

/snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu yi// lam rim cung zad bshad pa'i dges// 'gro kun zung 'jug myur thob shog /ces rje btsun 'ja' tshon gyi sku can ras chung zhabs nas gtso bor brgyud pa'i dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i lam rim snying por dril ba 'di yang*/ rang nyid kyi dran pa gso ba dang*/ las dang po pa gzhan dag la cung zad phan pa'i bsam pas/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang*/ gtsang smyon he ru ka yab sras sogs (101)kyi gsung la gzhi byas/ lam 'di la mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po bka' brgyud phrin las dbang phyug gi gsung gi bdud rtsis zur brgyan te/ rgyal khams nyul ba'i bya bral ba/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos/ grub pa'i bsti gnas ras chung phug tu mgo brtsams/ 'og min o rgyan smin grol gling nges pa don gyi dga' ba'i tshal chen por grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang sgrub brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa phyogs dang dus thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā ka lyā ṇaṃ bha ba tu/

'di rnams kyi go don rgyas par rje btsun mi la ras pas ras chung pa la chig brgyud du gdams pa'i bum dbang yid bzhin nor bu/ steng sgo rnam grol chos drug /phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed/ lam blo nas gcod pa bar do ngo sprod kyi khrid yig rnams gzhir bzung*/ grub chen gtsang smyon yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi gzhung 'grel khrid yig zhal shes dang bcas pa dang*/ kun mkhyen grub mchog dbang pos mdzad pa'i khrid yig chen mo rnams kyis gsal bar bya phyir bla ma'i zhal lung bzhin shes par bya ba kho na'o/// / (102)
